blocks.raw: # Tier Renewal & Downgrade
blocks.text: Tier Renewal & Downgrade

blocks.raw:
Tier renewal is the process of renewing a customer’s current tier for an additional period.  A renewal check is executed based on the expiration of the tier validity period, and if the conditions are satisfied, the customer qualifies for a tier renewal.\
Refer to [configuring tier validity](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/configure-renewal-conditions#configuring-validity-period) for more information.
blocks.text: Tier renewal is the process of renewing a customer’s current tier for an additional period.  A renewal check is executed based on the expiration of the tier validity period, and if the conditions are satisfied, the customer qualifies for a tier renewal.Refer to configuring tier validity for more information.

blocks.raw:
If a customer does not qualify for a tier renewal they will be downgraded to a lower tier.\
Refer to [configuring tier downgrade](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/configure-tier-downgrade) for more information.
blocks.text: If a customer does not qualify for a tier renewal they will be downgraded to a lower tier.Refer to configuring tier downgrade for more information.

blocks.raw: # Eligibility criteria
blocks.text: Eligibility criteria

blocks.raw: A customer can receive a tier renewal by meeting any of the eligibility criteria set in the program. The following are the criteria available for a tier renewal:
blocks.text: A customer can receive a tier renewal by meeting any of the eligibility criteria set in the program. The following are the criteria available for a tier renewal:

blocks.raw: ## 1. Purchase
blocks.text: 1. Purchase

blocks.raw: Purchases are the total amount a customer has spent throughout the tier validity period. The customer must meet a certain threshold of purchases set by the loyalty program to qualify for a tier renewal.
blocks.text: Purchases are the total amount a customer has spent throughout the tier validity period. The customer must meet a certain threshold of purchases set by the loyalty program to qualify for a tier renewal.

blocks.raw: ### Example
blocks.text: Example

blocks.raw: Consider the following case:
blocks.text: Consider the following case:

blocks.raw:
* Renewal eligibility for the tier: **$5000**
* Total purchases of the customer: **$4000**
blocks.text: Renewal eligibility for the tier: $5000Total purchases of the customer: $4000

blocks.raw: In this case, the customer has to make a purchase of at least **$1000** to  qualify for a renewal. If the customer does not reach **$5,000** in spending before the validity period ends, they will not qualify for a tier renewal, and their tier will be downgraded.
blocks.text: In this case, the customer has to make a purchase of at least $1000 to  qualify for a renewal. If the customer does not reach $5,000 in spending before the validity period ends, they will not qualify for a tier renewal, and their tier will be downgraded.

blocks.raw: ## 2. Number of visits
blocks.text: 2. Number of visits

blocks.raw: Number of visits is the total number of times a customer has visited the store throughout the tier validity period. The customer must meet a certain number of visits set by the loyalty program to qualify for a tier renewal.
blocks.text: Number of visits is the total number of times a customer has visited the store throughout the tier validity period. The customer must meet a certain number of visits set by the loyalty program to qualify for a tier renewal.

blocks.raw: ### Example
blocks.text: Example

blocks.raw: Consider the following case:
blocks.text: Consider the following case:

* Renewal eligibility for the tier: **10 store visits**
* Total visits of the customer: **8 store visits**
blocks.text: Renewal eligibility for the tier: 10 store visitsTotal visits of the customer: 8 store visits

blocks.raw: In this case, the customer has to visit the store at least **two** more times to qualify for a renewal. If the customer does not reach **ten store visits** before the validity period ends, they will not qualify for a tier renewal, and their tier will be downgraded.
blocks.text: In this case, the customer has to visit the store at least two more times to qualify for a renewal. If the customer does not reach ten store visits before the validity period ends, they will not qualify for a tier renewal, and their tier will be downgraded.

blocks.raw: ## 3. Points earned
blocks.text: 3. Points earned

blocks.raw: Points are the total points a customer has earned throughout the tier validity period. These include active, expired, and redeemed points. The customer must meet a certain threshold of points set by the loyalty program to qualify for the renewal.
blocks.text: Points are the total points a customer has earned throughout the tier validity period. These include active, expired, and redeemed points. The customer must meet a certain threshold of points set by the loyalty program to qualify for the renewal.

* Total points customer earned: **3500 points**

blocks.raw: ## 4. Trackers
blocks.text: 4. Trackers

blocks.raw: A tracker is a tool used to track custom values over a specific period and set it as an eligibility criterion for renewing the tier. Custom values can include bill amount, gross bill amount, points, line item price, and number of customer visits to the store.
blocks.text: A tracker is a tool used to track custom values over a specific period and set it as an eligibility criterion for renewing the tier. Custom values can include bill amount, gross bill amount, points, line item price, and number of customer visits to the store.

blocks.raw: Up to 3 trackers can be defined for a tier renewal.
blocks.text: Up to 3 trackers can be defined for a tier renewal.

For example, if the tracker threshold is set to 3000, this value is used for both upgrade and renewal eligibility. If you want to use different thresholds (such as 3000 for upgrade and 10000 for renewal), you must configure separate trackers for each operation.

blocks.raw: # Creating dynamic renewal criteria
blocks.text: Creating dynamic renewal criteria

blocks.raw: You can create dynamic criteria for tier renewal by combining multiple criteria. You can define up to three separate eligibility criteria for a tier renewal.
blocks.text: You can create dynamic criteria for tier renewal by combining multiple criteria. You can define up to three separate eligibility criteria for a tier renewal.

blocks.raw: There are three types of conditions you can set to define the renewal criteria:
blocks.text: There are three types of conditions you can set to define the renewal criteria:

blocks.raw: ## 1. Any (N-1) condition
blocks.text: 1. Any (N-1) condition

blocks.raw: The **Any (N-1)** operation can define the number of conditions required to qualify for a tier renewal. When this operation is applied, the customer must meet the specified number of criteria to qualify for a tier renewal.
blocks.text: The Any (N-1) operation can define the number of conditions required to qualify for a tier renewal. When this operation is applied, the customer must meet the specified number of criteria to qualify for a tier renewal.

blocks.raw: For example, assume there are 5 conditions/criteria defined in the renewal criteria of the tier. Now, when the "ANY" is selected, the brand will have the following options:
blocks.text: For example, assume there are 5 conditions/criteria defined in the renewal criteria of the tier. Now, when the "ANY" is selected, the brand will have the following options:

blocks.raw:
1. ANY 1
   1. This is just like a simple 'OR' condition. Among the 5 conditions, the user has to satisfy any 1 condition.
2. ANY 2
   1. Among the 5 conditions present, the user has to satisfy any 2 conditions.
3. ANY 3
   1. Among the 5 conditions present, the user has to satisfy any 3 conditions.
4. ANY 4
   1. Among the 5 conditions present, the user has to satisfy any 4 conditions.

Among the 5 conditions, the user has to satisfy any 1 condition.ANY 2Among the 5 conditions present, the user has to satisfy any 2 conditions.ANY 3Among the 5 conditions present, the user has to satisfy any 3 conditions.ANY 4Among the 5 conditions present, the user has to satisfy any 4 conditions.

blocks.raw: ## 1. Any (N-1) condition
blocks.text: 1. Any (N-1) condition

blocks.raw: The renewal criteria for the Gourmet tier are as follows:
blocks.text: The renewal criteria for the Gourmet tier are as follows:

blocks.raw:

* Visit the restaurant at least **10 times**
* Purchase at least **5** different menu items

2. [Create or edit](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-a-multi-loyalty-program#getting-started) an existing loyalty program and [create the tiers](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-tiers-and-configure-tier-upgrade-conditions#creating-a-tier) if required.

blocks.raw: # Tier downgrade
blocks.text: Tier downgrade

blocks.raw: When the customer does not satisfy the renewal conditions, they will be downgraded on the following:
blocks.text: When the customer does not satisfy the renewal conditions, they will be downgraded on the following:

blocks.raw: ## 1. One tier below
blocks.text: 1. One tier below

blocks.raw: The customer is downgraded to a tier lower than their current tier. If the customer is in the base tier, they will remain in the same tier.
blocks.text: The customer is downgraded to a tier lower than their current tier. If the customer is in the base tier, they will remain in the same tier.

blocks.raw: ## 2. An appropriate tier based on eligibility
blocks.text: 2. An appropriate tier based on eligibility

blocks.raw: The customer is reassessed against the tier upgrade criteria at the time of expiry and placed in the highest tier they currently qualify for.
blocks.text: The customer is reassessed against the tier upgrade criteria at the time of expiry and placed in the highest tier they currently qualify for.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 **Note:**
>
> * When **Appropriate tier based on eligibility** is selected as the downgrade strategy, renewal criteria are not evaluated, even if they have been configured. The customer's tier placement is determined solely by the tier upgrade criteria at the time of expiry.
> * If the tier upgrade criteria use a tracker with a cyclic window, only the transactions within the **current active cycle** count toward the customer's eligibility. If the tracker cycle resets close to the tier expiry date, the customer's accumulated value in the new cycle may be lower than in the previous cycle which can result in the customer being placed in a lower tier, even if their total spend across both cycles appeared sufficient.
